projects.title: Custom MCP Server
projects.summary: Built a Model Context Protocol server to expose internal tooling and data sources directly to AI agents, giving them typed, permissioned access to real systems instead of relying on copy-pasted context.

projects.title: Copilot Studio Skills Package
projects.summary: A curated library of production-grade agent skills covering document redlining, deck generation, and content commenting — each packaged with its own instructions, error handling, and anti-pattern guidance so behavior stays predictable.

projects.title: PowerPoint Agent Architecture
projects.summary: Designed an agent that produces genuinely on-brand decks from a corporate template, preserving master slides, theme colors, and layout integrity rather than generating slides from scratch.

projects.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration Patterns
projects.summary: Designed orchestration across many child agents resolving into a single unified response, working through the routing, context handoff, and failure behavior that decide whether a multi-agent setup is usable or just impressive in a demo.
